summary.name: Thunderbird
summary.one_liner: Thunderbird is a free, open-source desktop email client from Mozilla for managing multiple accounts, calendars, and contacts in one app.
use_cases: managing several email accounts in one place
organizing mail with tags and filters
keeping email private without data collection
reading messages, calendars and contacts in one app
receiving secure email on mobile with Thunderbird Mobile
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Thunderbird as a free email application that brings messages, calendars, and contacts into one app. Users can manage all accounts separately or view them in a unified inbox, and filter and organize mail in custom ways. It is presented as clean by default but customizable in appearance and workflow, and as extensible. Mozilla states it is funded by user donations, does not collect personal data or sell ads, and is open source. A newly introduced Thunderbird Mobile app is also mentioned.
notable: Funded by user donations and open source, with no personal data collection or ad sales
Tag feature for finding important messages
Extensible and customizable; Thunderbird Mobile companion app
caveats: Platform support for Thunderbird Mobile is not specified in the page text beyond its existence
Page is mostly promotional with few technical details
